Tender Notice – 1 (2016-17)
Tuesday, 26 April 2016
15964 Hits
The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items. The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of “The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by 12/05/2016 up to 1.00 PM. The tender fees of Rs. 2,000/- (nonrefundable) is to be paid by Cash or by enclosing D.D. favoring ‘Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram’ payable at Sevagram / Wardha.
Tender forms will be available in the office of the Dean (Central Purchase Section) on working days between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm. Tender forms also can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Dean reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
A. Cardiac OT Equipment:
1) Surgical Diathermy, 2) Sternal Saw Gun with Motor, 3) Heart Lung Machine, 4) Heating Cooling System, 5) LED Light Source, 6) ACT Machine, 7) IABP Machine (Intra Aortic Balloon Pump), 8) Blood & Fluid Warming System, 9) Hemodialysis Machine, 10) OT Lights, 11) Operating Table
Tender Document
B. Cardiac OT Instruments:
Coronary Set, Paediatric Cardiac Set, Pediatric OH Set, Adult OH Set, Leg Sets - 3, Adult Cardiac Set, Extra Instruments, DVR Sets, Thoracotomy Set, Wire Removal Sets
Tender Document
C. Neurosurgery Department:
1) High Definition Endo-Vision System with all accessories 2) Neuro Endoscopes 3) Ultra Sonic Surgical Aspirator
Tender Document
D. Oncosurgery Division:
1) Ethicon Linear Cutter & Stapler Metal (Reusable) 2) Khadilkar Multitrack Refractor 3) Vessel Sealer with other components / accessories
Tender Document
E. For CSSD Department:
1) Supply of Medical Gases (Refilling)
Tender Document
F. Linen Section:
1) Khadi (Clothes)
Tender Document
G. Microbiology Department:
1) Establishment of Annual Rate Contract for supply of Serology Kits
Tender Document
H. HIS Department:
1) USB Laser Barcode Scanner with Stand
Tender Document
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
